description: List your Besidka chats that have a live public share link, most recent activity first, with its expiry and what the link shows. The link itself (shareUrl) is included only when the connection can also change chats (chats:write). Use revoke_chat_shares to stop sharing. Requires signing in (chats:read).

limit.description: Chats per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 20

name: list_shared_chats
title: List my shared chats
